nodes.text:
🧵 Update on Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in India 🦠

1/ ICMR has detected 2 cases of HMPV in Karnataka during routine surveillance. Here's what you need to know: https://t.co/ntTRrKPeMu

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
2/ Case Details:

A 3-month-old girl with bronchopneumonia was treated and is now discharged.

An 8-month-old boy is recovering after testing positive on Jan 3, 2025.

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
3/ Key Points:

HMPV circulates globally, including in India.

No unusual rise in ILI (flu-like cases) or SARI has been reported.

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
4/ India’s health system is well-prepared:

Routine surveillance is robust.

Recent drills ensure quick action if needed.

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
5/ Preparedness in India:

The Union Health Ministry is closely monitoring HMPV trends and conducting surveillance.

WHO is also tracking global trends, including updates from China, to guide responses.

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text: 6/ India has conducted recent preparedness drills, demonstrating its capability to respond to respiratory health threats swiftly and effectively.

nodes.author: Drdoks
nodes.text:
This highlights the importance of routine surveillance and timely action to protect public health. Let’s stay informed and vigilant!
